settings.body: A damp cloth handles everyday dust and marks. Let the mat dry flat before putting hardware back on top.

settings.question: How do I choose the right size for my desk?
settings.answer: Measure the span your keyboard and mouse occupy when you work comfortably, then leave room on either side. The sizes offered for this mat are listed in the options above.
